criteria.requirement: Recommend a form matching legal-personality requirement and contractual partnership interests.

criteria.fail: Recommends SCSp as a distinct legal person or picks a form without reconciling legal personality and instruments.

criteria.requirement: Compare the three forms' membership and instrument structures rather than merely enumerating names.
criteria.pass: Explains SCS and SCSp have at least one distinct general and limited partner with partnership interests and SCA has general and limited shareholders with shares, while qualifying SCA as a share-company design rather than a simple SCS clone.
criteria.fail: Equates SCA interests with the SCS/SCSp partnership interests or omits distinct partner roles.

criteria.minimalPass: Two partner categories and interest-versus-share distinction in comparison.

criteria.requirement: Allocate investor and corporate general-partner exposures accurately.
criteria.pass: Identifies general partner as unlimited and solidarily liable for company obligations, limited partner's stake limited to its determined contribution absent prohibited external management, and checks distinct legal persons/roles in formation documents.
criteria.fail: Treats investor automatically liable like general partner or says corporate GP eliminates its own statutory unlimited exposure.

factRefs.quote: Neither party wants the investor to incur general-partner liability.

criteria.minimalPass: Corporate GP unlimited, investor limited contribution unless external-management breach.
criteria.nearMiss: Promises investor limited liability even when personally signing as external manager.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish internal consent/advice from prohibited third-party management.
criteria.pass: Treats consent for acquisitions exceeding EUR 2m where agreed in contract and investor advice/oversight as permissible without per se unlimited exposure; separately warns that external management toward third parties can trigger liability, including habitual acts on obligations not personally handled.
criteria.fail: Forbids all investor veto or advice, or calls external investor deal-making categorically safe.

criteria.requirement: Identify one material, legally supported assumption change that would alter the form recommendation, without inventing tax, licensing or property-transfer outcomes.
criteria.pass: Accept either a shift toward SCA if the investor actually needs share issuance/corporate share machinery, or reconsideration of SCSp if the separate-personality requirement is explicitly withdrawn. One decisive supported counterfactual suffices; do not require both. Withhold unsupported tax/regulatory/property-transfer conclusions.
criteria.fail: Offers no material change, relies solely on unsupported tax exemptions or regulated status, or falsely says SCSp acquires separate personality by registering assets in its name.
